title: Evaluate Icon-Only Control Review Prompt
task: In a fictional engineering repository, for a small copy icon, verify native button semantics, “Copy prompt body” naming, 44-pixel target, visible focus, Enter and Space activation, stable naming, and a separate copied-status announcement.
acceptance_criteria: A control inventory with purpose, element, accessible name, state, keyboard behaviour, target size, and feedback.
Runtime accessible-name and activation evidence for repeated, toggled, disabled, loading, and failure states.
Before-and-after screenshots or DOM evidence plus automated and manual limitations.
Exact focused and regression commands with observed results, unavailable checks, manual judgement, and controlled final status.
failure_signals: Reject icon-only controls with missing, ambiguous, duplicate, or state-inaccurate names.
Reject approval based solely on the presence of aria-label without activation and feedback evidence.
